name: @premai/bare-wasm3
description: WebAssembly polyfill for Bare using wasm3, wasm-bindgen compatible

scripts.build: bun run build:ios-arm64 && bun run build:android && bun run build:linux-arm64 && bun run build:linux-x64 && bun run build:darwin-arm64 && bun run mobile:copy-prebuilds
scripts.build:ios-arm64: bare-make generate --platform ios --arch arm64 --build build/ios-arm64 --define CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 && sh patch-wasm3.sh && bare-make build --build build/ios-arm64 && bare-make install --build build/ios-arm64
scripts.build:ios-arm64-simulator: bare-make generate --platform ios --arch arm64 --simulator --build build/ios-arm64-simulator --define CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 && sh patch-wasm3.sh && bare-make build --build build/ios-arm64-simulator && bare-make install --build build/ios-arm64-simulator
scripts.build:android-arm64: bare-make generate --define CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 --platform android --arch arm64 --build build/android-arm64 && sh patch-wasm3.sh && bare-make build --build build/android-arm64 && bare-make install --build build/android-arm64
scripts.build:linux-arm64: ZIG_TARGET=aarch64-linux-gnu sh -c 'bare-make generate --define CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 --define clang=$(pwd)/scripts/zig-cc --define clang++=$(pwd)/scripts/zig-c++ --platform linux --arch arm64 --build build/linux-arm64 && sh patch-wasm3.sh && bare-make build --build build/linux-arm64 && bare-make install --build build/linux-arm64'
scripts.build:linux-x64: ZIG_TARGET=x86_64-linux-gnu sh -c 'bare-make generate --define CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 --define clang=$(pwd)/scripts/zig-cc --define clang++=$(pwd)/scripts/zig-c++ --platform linux --arch x64 --build build/linux-x64 && sh patch-wasm3.sh && bare-make build --build build/linux-x64 && bare-make install --build build/linux-x64'
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: ZIG_TARGET=aarch64-macos sh -c 'bare-make generate --define CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 --define clang=$(pwd)/scripts/zig-cc --define clang++=$(pwd)/scripts/zig-c++ --platform darwin --arch arm64 --build build/darwin-arm64 && sh patch-wasm3.sh && bare-make build --build build/darwin-arm64 && bare-make install --build build/darwin-arm64'
scripts.mobile:copy-prebuilds: cp -r prebuilds/android-arm64 prebuilds/android-arm || echo 'android-arm prebuilds already present' && cp -r prebuilds/android-arm64 prebuilds/android-ia32 || echo 'android-ia32 prebuilds already present' && cp -r prebuilds/android-arm64 prebuilds/android-x64 || echo 'android-x64 prebuilds already present' && cp -r prebuilds/ios-arm64 prebuilds/ios-arm64-simulator || echo 'ios-arm64-simulator prebuilds already present' && cp -r prebuilds/ios-arm64 prebuilds/ios-x64-simulator || echo 'ios-x64-simulator prebuilds already present'
scripts.dev:build: bun run dev:build:ios-arm64 && bun run dev:build:android && bun run dev:build:linux-arm64 && bun run dev:build:linux-x64 && bun run dev:build:darwin-arm64 && bun run mobile:copy-prebuilds
scripts.dev:build:ios-arm64: bare-make generate --platform ios --arch arm64 --build build/ios-arm64 --define CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 --define CMAKE_C_FLAGS=-DBW3_DBG_ENABLED=1 && sh patch-wasm3.sh && bare-make build --build build/ios-arm64 && bare-make install --build build/ios-arm64
scripts.dev:build:android-arm64: bare-make generate --define CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 --define CMAKE_C_FLAGS=-DBW3_DBG_ENABLED=1 --platform android --arch arm64 --build build/android-arm64 && sh patch-wasm3.sh && bare-make build --build build/android-arm64 && bare-make install --build build/android-arm64
scripts.dev:build:linux-arm64: ZIG_TARGET=aarch64-linux-gnu sh -c 'bare-make generate --define CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 --define CMAKE_C_FLAGS=-DBW3_DBG_ENABLED=1 --define clang=$(pwd)/scripts/zig-cc --define clang++=$(pwd)/scripts/zig-c++ --platform linux --arch arm64 --build build/linux-arm64 && sh patch-wasm3.sh && bare-make build --build build/linux-arm64 && bare-make install --build build/linux-arm64'
scripts.dev:build:linux-x64: ZIG_TARGET=x86_64-linux-gnu sh -c 'bare-make generate --define CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 --define CMAKE_C_FLAGS=-DBW3_DBG_ENABLED=1 --define clang=$(pwd)/scripts/zig-cc --define clang++=$(pwd)/scripts/zig-c++ --platform linux --arch x64 --build build/linux-x64 && sh patch-wasm3.sh && bare-make build --build build/linux-x64 && bare-make install --build build/linux-x64'
scripts.dev:build:darwin-arm64: ZIG_TARGET=aarch64-macos sh -c 'bare-make generate --define CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 --define CMAKE_C_FLAGS=-DBW3_DBG_ENABLED=1 --define clang=$(pwd)/scripts/zig-cc --define clang++=$(pwd)/scripts/zig-c++ --platform darwin --arch arm64 --build build/darwin-arm64 && sh patch-wasm3.sh && bare-make build --build build/darwin-arm64 && bare-make install --build build/darwin-arm64'
